stages.label.purpose: Accessible name of the sidebar navigation.
stages.label.where: Sidebar (screen-reader label of the nav; not shown).

stages.overview.where: Sidebar link and the Overview screen's heading.

stages.review.where: Sidebar link and the Review screen's heading.

stages.allMusic.purpose: Name of the All music stage.
stages.allMusic.where: Sidebar link and the All music screen's heading.

stages.library.where: Sidebar link and the Library screen's heading.

stages.crates.where: Sidebar link in the Crates section, and the Crates screen's heading.

sidebar.noCrates.where: Sidebar, Crates section, under the Crates link.

search.label.where: Top bar, search slot (accessible name of the box and its group).

search.placeholder.where: Top bar, search slot (an inert placeholder for now).

search.shortcut.where: Top bar, beside the search box.

undo.button.purpose: The Undo button when there is nothing to undo.

undo.shortcut.where: Top bar, beside the Undo button.

undo.action.addToLibrary.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one track added to the Library.
undo.action.addToLibrary.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is an "Add to Library".

undo.action.removeFromLibrary.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one track removed from the Library.
undo.action.removeFromLibrary.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a "Remove from Library".

undo.action.addFromRekordbox_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: rekordbox tracks added to the Library in one go (one track).
undo.action.addFromRekordbox_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is the add of rekordbox tracks.

undo.action.addFromRekordbox_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: rekordbox tracks added to the Library in one go (several tracks).
undo.action.addFromRekordbox_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is the add of rekordbox tracks.

undo.action.createCrate.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate that was created.
undo.action.createCrate.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Create crate".

undo.action.renameCrate.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate rename, with the old and new names.
undo.action.renameCrate.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a crate rename.

undo.action.deleteCrate.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: a crate that was deleted.
undo.action.deleteCrate.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a crate delete.

undo.action.addToCrate_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one track added to a crate.
undo.action.addToCrate_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Add to crate".

undo.action.addToCrate_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: several tracks added to a crate.
undo.action.addToCrate_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is "Add to crate".

undo.action.removeFromCrate_one.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: one track removed from a crate.
undo.action.removeFromCrate_one.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a removal from a crate.

undo.action.removeFromCrate_other.purpose: Undo button naming what it takes back: several tracks removed from a crate.
undo.action.removeFromCrate_other.where: Top bar, Undo button, when the next step to undo is a removal from a crate.

undo.action.other.purpose: Undo button when the action it takes back has no name of its own.
undo.action.other.where: Top bar, Undo button, for an action this version has no wording for, or one recorded by an older version without its details.

undo.refused.sentSince.purpose: Says the next step can't be undone because the tracks it added have been sent to rekordbox since.
undo.refused.sentSince.where: Top bar, beside the greyed-out Undo button.
undo.refused.sentSince.approved: Can't undo: tracks have been sent to rekordbox since

undo.refused.sourceGone.purpose: Says a removal from the Library can't be undone because the track, or the file it was linked to, is gone from All music since (its music folder was removed, or the track was merged into another).
undo.refused.sourceGone.where: Top bar, beside the greyed-out Undo button.
undo.refused.sourceGone.approved: Can't undo: the track is no longer in All music

undo.refused.crateNameTaken.purpose: Says the next step can't be undone because it would bring back a crate name another crate has now.
undo.refused.crateNameTaken.where: Top bar, beside the greyed-out Undo button.
undo.refused.crateNameTaken.approved: Can't undo: crate name already used (“{{name}}”)

undo.refused.changedSince.purpose: Says the next step can't be undone because something it changed has changed again since.
undo.refused.changedSince.where: Top bar, beside the greyed-out Undo button.
undo.refused.changedSince.approved: Can't undo: the Library has changed since

details.label.purpose: Accessible name of the Details panel.
details.label.where: Details panel on the right (screen-reader label).

details.empty.where: Details panel, until selecting a track exists.

player.label.where: Player bar along the bottom (screen-reader label).
